ranking.order: descending; destructive ablations first, opposing heads last
ranking.rationale: Ranked on the signed causal effect of the ablation, not on its magnitude. A head whose removal *increases* the IOI logit difference is working against the behaviour, and ranking it alongside heads whose removal destroys it conflated the two.
